text:
Devon S (Eng): quick Q — baby arrived 2 weeks early, twins! i had planned parental leave starting 2025-06-15. how do i shift the start date and keep the Redwood top-up + onetime backfill stipend?
Clara P (People Ops): congrats and welcome twins :tada: you can change the leave start to actual birth date. please update the Parental Leave Request with new dates and upload the hospital discharge/certificate. we'll handle top-up/backfill if docs are verified.
Devon S (Eng): thanks. do I need a new manager approval or is pre-approval ok?
Ravi K (Eng Manager): i pre-approved the original plan. Devon, DM me the updated dates and i'll approve the change in the workflow. no problem on my end.
payroll-bot: FYI — process for early start:
```
1) Employee updates Parental Leave Request (new start/end)
2) Manager approves updated dates
3) People Ops verifies documentation
4) Payroll processes TOPUP and BACKFILL codes on next cycle
```
payroll-bot: note — onetime backfill stipend max = $1,500 or conversion of up to 40h PTO (employee choice). stipend is taxable supplemental income and processed within 2 payroll cycles after approval.
Benefits Team: health/dental remain active. twins may affect dependent coverage — please add second dependent in the benefits portal within 30 days to avoid gaps. we'll send a benefits confirmation email after verification.
Devon S (Eng): i have enough PTO for a 40h conversion, but would prefer the stipend. can I still switch to PTO conversion later?
Clara P (People Ops): yes — you can convert PTO instead if you change your preference before payroll cut for the stipend. once payroll processes the stipend, we can't retroactively convert. so update the form and note "PTO conversion" if you choose that.
Devon S (Eng): uploaded hospital discharge and updated dates to 2025-06-01 to 2025-08-01. DM'd Ravi. thanks all!
Ravi K (Eng Manager): approved in the form. :white_check_mark:
Clara P (People Ops): verified docs. payroll notified. Devon, expect TOPUP/BACKFILL on the next two pay cycles. congrats again and ping if you need lactation room scheduling or phased return templates.
Devon S (Eng): appreciate it. one last thing — on-call coverage: i arranged swaps for first 6 weeks. will follow up if anything changes.
Clara P (People Ops): perfect. enjoy the newborn chaos :heart:
